admission.cause: Inherited fake-scheduler fixture published its launches/PID marker before installing its release observer. Parent waits only for that marker/count before publishing release. The marker therefore did not establish the test's required observer-readiness premise. In the focused file this produced real child timeouts, not an authority/current-input rejection or failure to coalesce. Readiness marker ordering is the discriminating intervention; production scheduler/gates and Goal coverage stay unchanged.
admission.correction: Move the existing PID append after watch installation AND initial finish/release check. Add bounded JSON details to the same all-gates-ok assertion: each of6 indexes records ok and, if false, first400characters of reason. No added wait or timer; no scheduler policy change.

Production20s default, explicit10s check,10s launch-observation bound and3s timeout fixture are unchanged.
